How to score fairly
Grounding: Does every claim follow from the event? Penalize invented intentions, outcomes or confidence. Clarity: Can you understand it without extra explanation? Usefulness: Does it teach you something worth knowing or help you choose what to watch next?
Score each dimension from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Equal scores are valid. Missing tracking does not erase an earlier recorded event. A shot candidate does not prove a goal. Synthetic pass difficulty is not a real-world success probability.
Outputs were generated before you started. No AI requests are made by this review. Labels stay anonymous in this interface. Independence is self-attested and must be verified by the study organizer.
